Load the organometallic precursor

03
synthesis

Set reaction pressure and temperature

CO2 on the backside of the piston raises pressure; Dionex model 501 computer-controlled syringe pump. Heating tape with Omega CN76000 controller; an inserted thermocouple verifies reaction temperature. The precursor does not decompose at this stage before H2 is added.

04
synthesis

Introduce fluorinated thiol and hydrogen together

High-pressure injection pump and two six-port Valco rotary valves in series with sample loops introduce thiol and H2 simultaneously. No rate, dosing duration, agitation setting or sequential ligand-then-hydrogen operation is supplied. Absolute ligand/H2 charges are not resolved for this named experiment.
